ValidationRule.description: Prevents users without permissions to update Quantity, Customer Requested Date, or Unit Price fields unless the Approval Override checkbox is checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISCHANGED( Approval_Override__c ) ), NOT( $Permission.Allow_Order_Product_Fields_Override ), OR( ISCHANGED( Quantity ), ISCHANGED( Customer_Requested_Date__c ), ISCHANGED( UnitPrice ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Quantity, Customer Requested Date, or Unit Price can only be modified through an Approval.
